name: Feature Development
description: Implement a scoped feature through context, source analysis, planning, implementation, validation, and handoff.
approval_boundaries: Escalate incompatible interpretations of product behavior.
Do not introduce unrelated architecture changes.

phases.name: Repository context
phases.instructions: Gather relevant files, commands, constraints, and assumptions.

phases.name: Source-backed requirements
phases.instructions: Derive intended behavior from authoritative sources.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.instructions: Implement the planned behavior using the appropriate domain and testing skills.

phases.name: Validation
phases.instructions: Run focused tests, lint, build, or manual checks and package the result.
